seoTitle: Fix Shopify Buy It Now Button Not Showing Up
metaDescription: Restore a missing Buy It Now button on Shopify by enabling dynamic checkout and fixing theme or customization issues hiding it.
intro: A missing Buy It Now button can quietly hurt conversions since it removes a fast path to checkout for ready-to-buy customers. This guide covers why the button disappears, how to enable the dynamic checkout option, and how to resolve theme or customization conflicts that might be hiding it.

steps.heading: Understand why the Buy button is missing
steps.body: The Buy It Now button typically disappears due to a disabled dynamic checkout setting or a theme customization conflict.

steps.heading: Enable the dynamic checkout button
steps.body: Check your checkout settings to make sure the dynamic checkout option is turned on, since this controls whether the button appears at all.

steps.heading: Fix theme or customization issues
steps.body: If the setting is already enabled, look for theme edits or customizations that may be hiding the button on the product page.

steps.heading: Confirm the button is back
steps.body: After making changes, check your product pages to verify the Buy It Now button now displays correctly for customers.

faq.question: Why did my Buy It Now button disappear?
faq.answer: It's usually caused by the dynamic checkout button setting being disabled or a theme customization issue hiding it.

faq.question: Do I need to edit code to fix this?
faq.answer: In many cases, enabling the dynamic checkout setting is enough, though some theme customization issues may require deeper inspection.

faq.question: Will this fix work on any Shopify theme?
faq.answer: The steps focus on checkout settings and general theme customization issues that can apply across different Shopify themes.

faq.question: How can I confirm the fix worked?
faq.answer: Visit your product page after making the changes to confirm the Buy It Now button is visible again.
